cd /opt/trading-bot/classic && python3 -W ignore <<'PYEOF'
import json
r = json.load(open('runs.json'))
print(f'\n{"="*75}')
print(f'ПРОГОНЫ: {len(r)} штук')
print(f'{"="*75}\n')
for x in r:
    trades = len(x.get('trades', []))
    result = sum(t.get('net', 0) for t in x.get('trades', []))
    win = sum(1 for t in x.get('trades', []) if t.get('net', 0) > 0)
    status = f'сделок {trades:2d} | итог {result:+6.1f}% | в плюсе {win:2d}' if trades else 'нет сделок'
    print(f'id {x["id"]:2d} | {x["name"]:45s} | {status}')
print()
